composition.serve_who: Sheet GMMS 108'-114a "BILGE SYSTEM" is a wiring/control sheet covering three equipment groups: (1) the MAIN BILGE PUMP (motor + local switch + solenoid contactor circuit, top of sheet) — matches established node 520-main-bilge-pump and its known multi-switch control loop; (2) the five electrically-actuated BILGE VALVES (Burkert rotary actuators) for Eng.Room/Lazarette/Aft/Fwd/Sail Locker bilge lines, each captioned "BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE" (caption-attaches-to-device-below convention; the same physical valve-controller graphic is reused per branch, but the level-switch label to its right — PORT/STBD LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG ROOM, FWD, SAIL LOCKER — identifies which zone each valve actually serves) — matches 520-bilge-valves; (3) the bilge level switches themselves (PORT LAZARETTE, STBD LAZARETTE, AFT, ENG ROOM, FWD, SAIL LOCKER BILGE SW) feeding status into the relay bank/terminal strip and onward to the MAIN PANEL PC CARD open/closed indicators — these are sensing/monitoring components of the same 520-bilge-valves control loop (status back-path), not a separate node. The MAIN PANEL, PLUG C/D, PEDESTAL ALARM+MUTE and PC CARD are the panel/monitoring infrastructure (641-vessel-control-panel) that displays/commands these loops — infrastructure, not itself equipment. XA40/XA10/XA11 tags are status-signal stubs to Onyx monitoring (652-onyx-monitoring) per the explicit 'to ONYX' pointer near Re6/T/S B terminal 13.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Top-of-sheet motor labelled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' fed via F3 60A fuse, switch SW8, SO6, and T/S S (terminals 13/14/15) local pump switch — matches established node's control_loop fact (multi-switch activation: local switch / main panel S13 / ONYX). This sheet is the source drawing for that established fact.

functions.label: Main bilge pump run/stop control (multi-source)
functions.what_it_does: Energises the main bilge pump motor's solenoid contactor coil so the pump runs; the coil circuit can be closed from any of three independent sources feeding the same T/S S terminals 13/14/15.

flow_scenarios.path: F3 60A fuse -> SW8 -> SO6 -> T/S S (13/14/15) idle -> contactor coil de-energised -> pump motor stopped
LOCAL PUMP SW (front panel toggle, terminals 1/2) -> T/S S terminals 13/14 -> solenoid contactor coil energised -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs
MAIN PANEL S13 'BILGE PUMP SW' -> Plug C pins 6/7 -> T/S C terminals 48/49/50 -> up wiring loom -> T/S S coil terminals -> contactor energised -> pump runs
ONYX remote (off-sheet) -> loom stub near Re6/T/S B terminal 13 labelled 'to ONYX' -> T/S S coil path -> contactor energised -> pump runs

functions.dry_data: Fed via F3 60A fuse; local switch SW8/SO6; coil terminals T/S S 13/14/15; solenoid contactor drives DC motor pump.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bilge Valves (electric rotary actuators) + Bilge Level Switches — control/monitoring loop
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Five OPEN/CLOSE valve-controller blocks (each captioned 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' per the reused graphic, per sheet convention) are wired through relays Re1-Re5 and T/S C terminals to the zone-named level switches on the right (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) and onward to Main Panel Plug C / PC card open-closed indicators. Node 520-bilge-valves already carries the BOM identity (Burkert 2-way DN050 actuators x5) and Q14 supply fact from the electrical distribution sheet; this sheet supplies the per-zone OPEN/CLOSE control loop and status-indication wiring for those same valves, plus their associated bilge level float switches used as automatic close/inhibit sensors.

functions.label: Eng. Room bilge valve open/close control + level-switch status (Re1 branch)
functions.what_it_does: Opens or closes the Eng. Room bilge suction valve on command from the Main Panel, and reports valve open/closed status plus PORT & STBD LAZARETTE bilge-level switch state back to the Main Panel PC card indicators and to ONYX monitoring.

flow_scenarios.path: Bilge Valves supply Q13 10A -> T/S B terminal 8 -> Re1 relay coil idle -> valve motor [2]/[3] stationary; level switches open (dry) -> no alarm
Main Panel OPEN switch -> T/S C terminals 7/8 -> Re1 contacts -> valve motor terminals [2]/[3] -> valve drives OPEN -> status tap XA40<14>/XA40<12> to Onyx monitoring
Main Panel CLOSE switch -> T/S C terminals 7/8 (opposite contact) -> Re1 contacts -> valve motor -> valve drives CLOSED
PORT LAZARETTE BILGE SW / STBD LAZARETTE BILGE SW float closes -> line into T/S C terminals 12/13/14/15 -> Main Panel PC card indicator lamp (open/closed) -> status also tapped to Onyx via XA40

functions.dry_data: Relay Re1; T/S C terminals 1-2,7-15; status taps XA40<14>, XA40<12>; supply Q13 10A (Bilge Valves feeder, shared infrastructure).
functions.sheet_region: rows 1 (Re1/T/S8) of controller_module bbox [0.55,0.25,0.72,0.78] and level switches [0.75,0.3,0.92,0.78]

functions.what_it_does: Opens or closes the Aft bilge suction valve on command, and reports valve status plus AFT bilge level switch state to Main Panel and Onyx.

flow_scenarios.path: Q13 10A -> T/S B terminal 9 -> Re2 coil idle -> valve stationary; AFT BILGE SW dry -> no alarm

infrastructure.system_name: Vessel Control Panel — Bilge System interface (Plug C, Plug D, PC Card, Pedestal Alarm)
facts: PLUG C: pins 1-5 map to LAZARETTE BILGE / AFT BILGE / ENG. ROOM BILGE / FWD BILGE / SAIL LOCKER; pins 6/7 route to BILGE PUMP SW (S13) on Main Panel.
MAIN PANEL indicator switches S20-S24 labelled LAZARETTE BILGE, AFT BILGE, ENG. ROOM BILGE, FWD BILGE, SAIL LOCKER; S13 = BILGE PUMP SW.
AUX PLUG ON PC BOARD: [8]->>[1], [9]->>[2], [10]->>[3], [11]->>[4] — auxiliary status taps feeding the PC card from valve loops.
MAIN PANEL PC CARD: open/closed indicator lamps for each bilge zone (lines 7-10 confirmed: 7-open, 8-closed FWD BILGE, 9-open, 10-closed SAIL LOCKER), diode array, +24V supply.
PLUG D: 12-pin pass-through terminal strip (1-[1]-1 ... 10-[10]-10) linking Main Panel wiring to the PC Card.
PEDESTAL ALARM + MUTE module (ALARM MOD) wired via its own 4-pin block (1-[1]-1 ... 4-[4]-4) into the Main Panel loom — alarm/mute function for bilge high-level alerts.

infrastructure.system_name: Bilge Valves supply feeder (breaker Q13 10A) and relay/terminal wiring backbone
facts: BILGE VALVES Q13 10A breaker feeds T/S B terminals 8-13 (one per relay Re1-Re6).

T/S C is the central 50-terminal wiring strip carrying OPEN/CLOSE commands, valve motor terminals [2]/[3], and level-switch returns for all five valve/level-switch branches plus the Re6/bilge-pump loop stub.
Numbers in diamonds on T/S C wires (e.g. 12,13,21,22,29,30,37,38,45,46) are wire-gauge callouts, not devices.
